title: Automatic update not finding updates anymore
body:
### Automatic update does not find updates anymore
When I tap "check for updates", I get a toast message reporting that xdrip checks for updates. After that nothing is happening - although I'm not on the latest build.

### Environment
- The last automatic update that worked was to "Nightly build 27th Nov 2020". I've first realized this a few days ago. Today, I updated to the second-latest nightly (from 16th December). It didn't succeed either to show there is an update to the build from 18th Dec. When I check the logs, I can see it notices a difference to my version on wearos each time I request the update check but no other message show up.
- I'm on a Nokia 7 with December 2020 security patches.


### Expected behavior
In the past, the screen showed up with the option to download the latest version. I'm not sure about the expected behaviour in case there is no update - I'd expect a notification about being up to date.

### Actual behavior
Nothing happens after the initial "Checking for updates .." toast.

comments.body: I just realized that I was saying "automatic" and described the manual workflow. Needless to say the automatic check does not provide results either.
Do you have your own build of xDrip installed or the public version?
Are you sure you are still on the "Nightly" channel?

I am and have been using the APK published here. I double checked my settings and I am still on nightly.

Is there a log tag I could whitelist to get more detailed log entries?
Same here, I've checked that I'm on the nightly channel, but updates will not be found

I've checked the code and added tag filters. Maybe someone can hint me at why I don't get any log entries? I've added "jamorham update:v" but no entries showed up. Anyway, assuming the log just wasn't written but the update check is working, I checked the URL and it seems the service reports the November 27th as the latest nightly!
https://xdrip-plus-updates.appspot.com/update-check/nightly responds:

> 2011270800
> https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/download/2020.11.27/xDrip-plus-20201127-b978bec.apk?
> 11716485
> 
> 6726580bc7ef215fd0c79859ccf9ea0b381fc9bd99210de8f64d7ad06e55a12c

@jamorham It looks like your [update-check](https://xdrip-plus-updates.appspot.com/update-check) does not work correctly. I thought it only provides updates till `2011270800` because I added a warning to the release of 2020.12.10. But after removal of this warning, the update-check did not recognize newer releases.

jamorham posted at gitter: "Recent changes to the CI server caused the issue, the nightly update channel should be working again now."
I can confirm that it works, now.
